validated_envelope.evidence: every measured benchmark has one substrate: docs/validation.md section 7

measured benchmarks that agree: eps_r 2.2 (Sheen 1990 patch, -1.0 %) and 2.33 (Chang 1986 patches, -1.2 to +1.4 %). The alumina line (9.9) reads eps_eff 1.1 to 1.7 % high, so it is not included: docs/validation.md section 7

validated_envelope.parameter: thickness of "core" in wavelengths at 8 GHz
validated_envelope.evidence: Chang 1986 measured patches: within 2.4 % up to h/lambda_d 0.11 (one row -3.2 %); above it NobuRF reads high, +5 % at 0.125 rising to +15 % at 0.23 with a lumped feed (docs/validation.md section 7.4)

frequency-dependent and magnetic materials match the closed-form slab reflection and transmission coefficients within 6e-3, most within 2e-3 (docs/validation.md section 2.4), but no measured board or ferrite part has checked them yet
the measured resonances that agree lie between 2.31 GHz (Chang 1986) and 7.5 GHz (Sheen 1990 patch): docs/validation.md section 7

the measured benchmarks that agree are one-port patches with a lumped feed; the Sheen 1990 four-port branch-line coupler reads 7 to 9 % low, and the SMA edge launch and coax probe are checked against openEMS only (docs/validation.md sections 3.2, 7)
copper loss matches the Pozar 6.3 cavity wall Q within 0.3 %, but has no measured strip-loss benchmark yet (docs/validation.md sections 7.2, 7.3)
every benchmark has axis-aligned copper; slanted or curved edges are staircased on the grid, which the mesh band measures but no benchmark has checked

warnings: mesh: smallest cell 0.200 mm is below edge_cell (0.5 mm) and sets the time step; look for copper edges, the port or layer interfaces closer together than edge_cell. Copper edge lines sit about a third of edge_cell inside the drawn edge, so gaps between lines are rarely whole cells and the grading may shrink cells near them

outside the validated range: eps_r of "core" is 4.4 (validated: 2.2 to 2.33), so the model is unproven against measurement here. measured benchmarks that agree: eps_r 2.2 (Sheen 1990 patch, -1.0 %) and 2.33 (Chang 1986 patches, -1.2 to +1.4 %). The alumina line (9.9) reads eps_eff 1.1 to 1.7 % high, so it is not included: docs/validation.md section 7
